<b>Lumble the Lucky</b> is a [[NPCs (Silksong)#Merchants|merchant]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. He offers to play a dice-throwing game with [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]].

== Background ==
Lumble is a traveller on his way to [[the Citadel]], found resting alone in the [[Blasted Steps]].

== In-game Events ==
The dice minigame can be initiated by talking to Lumble the Lucky after exhausting his initial encounter dialogue.

Lumble owns {{R|16}} when he is first encountered.<ref><code>PlayerData.dicePilgrimBank</code> in <code>Assembly-CSharp.dll</code>.</ref> He gains {{R|4}} from Hornet every time he wins the dice minigame, and loses {{R|4}} to Hornet every time he loses. In order to exhaust Lumble's Rosaries, Hornet must win all of the Rosaries he originally owned, in addition to any Rosaries he gains from winning the game. If Hornet wins again after exhausting Lumble's Rosaries, he gives her the Magnetite Dice. Once this happens, the title "the Lucky" is removed from his name.

If the Magnetite Dice were not won from him, Lumble is found dead once the [[Cogwork Dancers]] are defeated or the [[Clawline]] is acquired, and the dice can be obtained from his body. If the dice were won from him, his body can instead be found in the room before the [[Last Judge]] arena. However, if the dice are not picked up by the time [[Act 3]] begins, they are looted and sold at [[Grindle]]'s shop in the Blasted Steps for {{R|300}}.

=== How to Play ===
Hold the [[Controls (Silksong)|BIND]] button to shake the dice. Releasing the button causes Hornet to roll the dice. Afterwards, Lumble rolls his dice, and a winner is decided based on the number rolled (which cannot be seen on screen). The winner gains {{R|4}}, and the loser loses {{R|4}}. If there is a tie, no Rosaries are gained or lost.

It is possible to guarantee a win in the dice minigame. In order to do so, let go of the button as Hornet turns her wrist to face a different direction. This can be timed by letting go on the 14th shake of the dice. The dice shine white on the 15th shake, but releasing at that point is probably too late. Successfully executing this causes Hornet to grunt as she lets go of the dice, and she wins the round. Alternatively, using a timer and releasing on the 5th second (if the timer starts as soon as the game begins) guarantees a win.

== Location ==
Lumble the Lucky can be found in the [[Blasted Steps]], west of the [[Bellway]] station.

If the [[Magnetite Dice]] were won from him, Lumble's corpse can be found in the room before the [[Last Judge]] arena.

== Trivia ==
* Lumble uses the word beat as a unit of measure equal to four.<ref>Lumble: <i>"A beat of rosaries on each roll."</i></ref> The same word appears in the [[Lore Tablets (Silksong)|Lore Tablets]] in reference to the size of shipments that [[Dreg Workers]] and [[Dock Workers]] are required to make.<ref>Greymoor [[Lore Tablets (Silksong)#Greymoor|Lore Tablet]]: <i>"On the eighth harvest, send: Fifty measures, nine beats dregthread, spooled, Fourteen measures dregthread, twined, Oath of fealty, all workers. On the twelfth harvest, send: Forty measures dregthread, spooled, Two beats fine thread, twined, Oath of fealty, all workers."</i></ref><ref>Deep Docks [[Lore Tablets (Silksong)#Deep Docks|Lore Tablet]]: <i>"At the seventh bell toll, send: Thirty measures, four beats Smokerock, Eight beats Sweetsmelt, Mark of fealty, all workers. At the ninth bell toll, send: Twenty measures, two beats Smokerock, Seven beats Sweetsmelt, Mark of fealty, all workers."</i></ref>
* Originally, most translations of the game referred to Lumble as male, but many were later changed to female in [[Updates (Silksong)#1.0.29242 (Patch 4)|1.0.29242 (Patch 4)]] under "Various localisation fixes implemented across all languages."
* Early in development, Lumble the Lucky was planned to appear in the first room of the later-cut [[Cut Content (Silksong)/Areas#Red Coral Gorge|Red Coral Gorge]] area.
